questions.learningObjective: identify the on-yomi of a kanji

stimulus.body: 次の語について考えましょう：chi。

questions.stem: What is the on-yomi reading of the kanji 遅 meaning "late"?

options.misconception: gives the reading of a different kanji rather than the on-yomi of 遅
gives the reading of a different kanji rather than the on-yomi of 遅
gives the reading of a different kanji rather than the on-yomi of 遅

questions.explanation: The kanji 遅, meaning "late", has the on-yomi chi. The on-yomi is the reading borrowed from Chinese and is common in compound words, while the kun-yomi is the native Japanese reading used when the character stands alone.
questions.hint: Recall the Chinese-derived reading borrowed for the kanji 遅.
